implementation: Separately labeled UIKit/Objective-C++ interface around updated/native recovered CutOut operators; original Android and prototype sources unchanged.

build.signing_scope: Locally development-signed device build; signing identity and provisioning details omitted.
build.source_snapshot_scope: Current app sources, native C++/headers, Xcode project/scheme/generator, resources, dependency metadata and build scripts; test code recorded separately under UI checks and documentation excluded.

runtime.scope: Eight procedural ellipse runs cover FIGTree/histogram × pixel-grid/level-set × hard/refined alpha. Four coffee runs cover FIGTree × pixel-grid/level-set × hard/refined alpha at a 400-pixel working limit; two additional refined coffee runs use full 600×400 resolution.
runtime.timing_scope: Image/stroke conversion, native segmentation and UIImage creation; excludes PNG persistence
runtime.timing_limitations: Single-run observations include conversion and UIImage creation, exclude PNG persistence, and are not a performance benchmark.

offline_artifact_validation.seed_png_interpretation: Opaque RGBA, identical binary RGB intensity channels; alpha is not seed membership.
offline_artifact_validation.color_encoding_scope: Opaque cutout RGB is checked exactly. Fractional-alpha RGB differences from input are reported descriptively in 8-bit channel levels; alpha-zero RGB is not evaluated.
assertions: One completed batch; exact scenario/options set; 14 unique run directories; saved completion marker and index agree.
All five PNGs per run have expected dimensions; binary masks contain foreground/background; selected-pixel metadata matches.
Nonempty disjoint seed masks; all foreground/background seeds agree with binary mask and opaque/transparent cutout alpha.
Every opaque cutout RGB pixel equals the corresponding input RGB pixel; hard cutout alpha equals binary mask.
All six coffee input RGB arrays equal the pinned CC0 fixture.
Six hard/refined pairs have identical input/seed pixels, ordered strokes and binary selection masks.

ui_checks.runner_build: UI test target compiled and signed; initialization attempted on the physical device.
ui_checks.blocker: XCTest runner initialization timed out while enabling automation mode, before any UI test cases started.
ui_checks.scope: No application UI pass/fail result can be inferred from this runner initialization failure.

latest_test_build.scope: Current Xcode project and UI test runner compile/sign only; no UI test cases executed by build-for-testing.

visual_review.scope: Actual coffee input, binary mask and checkerboard-composited cutout inspected for all six configurations.
observations: Pixel-grid distance retains substantial wood above the cup and small side patches with these scribbles.
Level-set distance isolates the cup/saucer more closely in this fixture but still has boundary errors and retained background.
Alpha refinement changes contour transparency; each tested hard/refined pair retains the same binary selection.
Two FIGTree ellipse refined cases have no fractional alpha pixels; refinement need not change every contour.

limitations: One physical iPhone and one OS version were exercised; simulator and other iOS versions are not established by this record.
Fourteen saved native executions are integration cases, not accuracy benchmarks or the 31-case desktop native regression suite.
Artifact inspection validates consistency, input identity and selected seed constraints; it does not independently authenticate the device.
The saved batch index does not embed an executable digest; build-output and source-snapshot hashes are recorded separately.
No reference-mask accuracy, original historical APK equivalence, cross-platform pixel identity, training or general correctness is claimed.
UI interactions and deliberate save-failure injection are outside this batch record unless separately recorded.
